pages.name: About
pages.seoDescription: Who Copper & Cole is, what we do and the people behind the work.

children.class: mx-auto grid w-full max-w-5xl items-center gap-10 @3xl:grid-cols-2 @3xl:gap-16

children: We opened Copper & Cole in 2014 to run a barbershop the old way — real barbers, sharp tools, and time taken over every cut and shave.
No franchise script, no upsell, no ten-minute turnaround. Just good work done properly, for men who want to look after themselves.

children: A chair’s a chair. Book ahead and it’s yours, or walk in and we’ll take you as soon as one opens.
Clippers, shears and a straight razor, all maintained the way they should be. It shows in the finish.
Find the one who gets your cut and book them by name. They’ll know your head before you sit down.
